craft_notes: Sthāyin: mudrā-vīra of sealing — girt-am → nectar-life → eightfold-circle → seals-all → loosed-called → draught-dwells → moment-rises → effortless-all; the treatise seals effortless. Loosed-melted-sealed-called (four verbs one breath); wealth-of-every-kind. Rejected: (a) trimming verbs → killed: four are the sealing. Read aloud: LOOSED noose-NETS, MELT-ed-MARKS … SEAL so-CALLED.

lines: Loosed noose-nets, melted marks — Your shape, Lord, seals
knowing-wealth of every kind — seal so called.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mocayati pāśajālaṃ drāvayati vibhedam īśa te mūrtiḥ mudrayati vividhasaṃviddraviṇaṃ mudrā tataḥ kathitā

reads_against.argmap: What is loosed and called seal? → Loosed-melted sealed wealth called seal.
c1_essence: Sealed all delighted throng by fullness-shown.
Conquering draught dwells clearly; stain known.
In-me flashing sealed; rite complete effortless.
